title: Petal calls v1
description: calls/v1 (12 Nov): one open call, someone paying for work or asking for a vote right now: a request for proposals, a grants program, a bounty, a hackathon, an accelerator, a fund, or an open vote. Read from a public source without a key, every field as that source says it: a status is kept as said beside its deadline, even when the two disagree, and a budget in the call's own words. Its fields follow the RFP Object Standard's (DAOIP-5, schema.org/Grant), so other tools can read Petals' feed. Any agent can write one.

id.description: the call's own id where its source gives one, as <source>:<id> (karma:1508, infrastructure-committee.near:8); else its link

kind.description: what kind of call, as its source says it: an open vote calls a DAO's voters, not for work

summary.description: its short description, as said; null when the source gives none

offered_by.description: who offers it: the DAO, program or community by name, and its address on Petals' shared map when the chain ties the two

about.description: the map's address (its card's id), or null

budget.description: the budget in the call's own words and currency, never a dollar figure it didn't give; null when it says none

opens.description: when it opened, as said, or null

closes.description: its deadline, as said, or null when it has none

status.description: its status in its source's own words (ACCEPTING_SUBMISSIONS, Active, active), or null

link.description: where to read it and apply

source.description: where and when it was read

name.description: the source: karma, infrastructure-committee.near, snapshot, a forum's host

ref.description: what was read: the address of the list, or the chain's account and view call

how.description: sourced: the source itself says it is an open call. inferred: a reading that a post is one, with the post as evidence

evidence.description: for an inferred call, the post it was read from
